definitions.explanation: Asking someone to do something; placing an order for a service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{依頼|いらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{依頼|いらい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To request an expert to conduct an investigation.

examples.japanese: {依頼|いらい}⟦{主|ぬし}→主：noentry⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: To wait for contact from the client.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{依頼|いらい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I asked a friend to help with moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客|きゃく}さま→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{依頼|いらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: There are so many requests from clients that this week is very busy.

notes:
{依頼|いらい} is a formal way to express requesting something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {依頼|いらい}する (to request, commission)
- {依頼|いらい}を{受|う}ける (to receive a request)
- 〜に{依頼|いらい}する (to request from ~)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {依頼|いらい}{者|しゃ}/{依頼|いらい}{主|ぬし} (client, requester)
- {依頼|いらい}{書|しょ} (written request)
- {依頼|いらい}{内容|ないよう} (details of request)

FORMALITY:
- More formal than {頼|たの}む (to ask)
- Used in business and professional contexts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頼|たの}む: to ask (casual)
- {要請|ようせい}: request (formal, official)
- {注文|ちゅうもん}: order (for products)
